basic_details.short_information: The post of Director is open in five National Institutes (Autonomous Bodies) under the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (Divyangjan) (DEPwD), Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India. It pays Level 13 in the Pay Matrix (Rs. 1,23,100 to Rs. 2,15,900) on deputation, or a consolidated Rs. 1,75,000 a month on contract with no allowances including HRA. Applicants need a Post Graduate Degree with 55% marks and, for contract, 15 years' experience. The tenure is initially 3 years, extendable up to a maximum of 5 years. Applications in the prescribed proform

age_limit.details: The maximum age for applying on deputation or contract is 56 years, reckoned as on the closing date of receipt of applications. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility wording.

qualification.details: Post Graduate Degree in any discipline, preferably in Special Education or Rehabilitation, from a recognized University/Institution with minimum 55% marks or equivalent grade.

selection_process: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview. Selection on contract will be made only when suitable candidates are not available on deputation. The notice does not give the interview date or venue.
how_to_apply: The application is offline, in the prescribed proforma attached to the notice (in English and Hindi).
Fill the application proforma, writing the name of the National Institute applied for and whether you are applying on deputation or contract, and paste a passport size photograph.
Give employment details in chronological order starting with the latest; attach a separate sheet signed by you if space is short.
Contract applicants must fill the Cost to Company (CTC) table for 2021-22 to 2025-26 and attach supporting documents.

Enclose a Demand Draft of Rs. 1000/- in favour of "PAO, Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities", payable at SBI, Shastri Bhawan, New Delhi. A separate Demand Draft must go with each application form.
Get the employer/forwarding authority certificate filled (no vigilance/disciplinary case, integrity, no penalty in the last 10 years, ACRs/APARs enclosed).

Send the application through proper channel (wherever applicable) to: Shri Ashish Thakare, Director, Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (Divyangjan), Room No. 517A, 5th Floor, Pt. Deendayal Antyodaya Bhawan, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi-110003.
The application must reach within 42 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News/Rozgar Samachar. The publication date in Employment News is not given in the notice.
Application in the prescribed format, completed in all respects, with a passport size photograph
Demand Draft of Rs. 1000/- for each application
CTC supporting documents for the last five years (contract applicants)
important_instructions: Applications received without requisite documents or after the last date will not be entertained. An advance copy received from an eligible candidate before the last date may be considered, provided the duly forwarded application with required documents is received before the interview is scheduled. Forwarding departments/organizations should ensure that officials who apply shall not be allowed to withdraw their candidature later in case of selection. Candidates may submit separate applications for each National Institute, but multiple applications for the same National Institute shall not be entertained. The Competent Authority reserves the right to cancel, withdraw or alter the vacancy without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: About DEPwD
content_sections.text: The Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (Divyangjan) is a department of the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India, with its office at Pt. Deendayal Antyodaya Bhawan, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi. The Director posts are in five National Institutes, which are autonomous bodies under the department's administrative control. The notice says it is to be uploaded on the website of the Department and the National Institutes.

National Institute for Empowerment of Persons with Multiple Disabilities, Chennai
Swami Vivekanand National Institute of Rehabilitation Training and Research, Cuttack
Pt. Deendayal Upadhyaya National Institute for Persons with Physical Disabilities, New Delhi
National Institute for Locomotor Disabilities, Kolkata

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited for both deputation and contract. However, contractual mode of selection will be subject to non-suitability of candidates on deputation. Officers under Central/State Government, Universities, Public Sector Undertakings, or Autonomous/Statutory Organizations who meet any one of these: Drawing pay in Pay Scale/Level 13 of the Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC or equivalent grade, and minimum 5 years' experience in research or rehabilitation or administration in any field, preferably in the field of Disability; OR 5 years' regular service in any grade drawing salary in Pay Scale/Level 12 as per 7th CPC or equivalent grade, and 5 years' experience in research or rehabilitation or administration in any field, preferably in the field of Disability; OR 8 years' regular service in any grade drawing salary in Pay Scale/Level 11 as per 7th CPC or equivalent grade, and 5 years' experience in research or rehabilitation or administration in any field, preferably in the field of Disability. 15 years' experience of research or rehabilitation or administration in any Government/Registered Non-Government/Entity Organization/Company, preferably in the field of Disability; AND Drawing a minimum CTC (Cost to Company) of Rs. 6,00,000/- (rupees six lakhs only) per annum for the last five years. Post Graduate Degree in any discipline, preferably in Special Education or Rehabilitation, from a recognized University/Institution with minimum 55% marks or equivalent grade. Ph.D. in any discipline. The maximum age for applying on deputation or contract is 56 years, reckoned as on the closing date of receipt of applications. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility wording.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Deputation: Level 13 in the Pay Matrix (Rs. 1,23,100/- to Rs. 2,15,900/-). Contract: Consolidated remuneration of Rs. 1,75,000/- per month with provision of annual increment @3.00%. An applicant selected on contract basis will be given consolidated pay and will not be entitled to any allowances, including House Rent Allowance (HRA) or Travelling Allowance (TA). Tenure will be initially for a period of 03 years and thereafter extendable up to a maximum of 05 years, subject to applicability as per DoPT norms. Deputation/Contract will be governed as per Central Government rules of deputation as amended from time to time.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DEPwD Director
content_sections.text: The application is offline, in the prescribed proforma attached to the notice (in English and Hindi). Application in the prescribed format, completed in all respects, with a passport size photograph Self-attested copies of testimonials/certificates Last five years ACRs/APARs Integrity Certificate and Vigilance Clearance Demand Draft of Rs. 1000/- for each application CTC supporting documents for the last five years (contract applicants)

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview. Selection on contract will be made only when suitable candidates are not available on deputation. The notice does not give the interview date or venue.

Forwarding departments/organizations should ensure that officials who apply shall not be allowed to withdraw their candidature later in case of selection. Candidates may submit separate applications for each National Institute, but multiple applications for the same National Institute shall not be entertained. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date for the DEPwD Director application?
faq.answer: Applications must reach DEPwD within 42 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News/Rozgar Samachar. Late applications will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q2. Which National Institutes have Director vacancies?
faq.answer: Director posts are in five National Institutes: Dehradun, Chennai, Cuttack (anticipated on 04.11.2026), New Delhi (anticipated on 01.11.2026) and Kolkata (anticipated on 01.12.2026).

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for DEPwD Director?
faq.answer: A Post Graduate Degree in any discipline, preferably in Special Education or Rehabilitation, with minimum 55% marks or equivalent grade is essential. A Ph.D. in any discipline is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for DEPwD Director?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years for both deputation and contract, reckoned as on the closing date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of DEPwD Director?
faq.answer: Deputation pay is Level 13 (Rs. 1,23,100 to Rs. 2,15,900). Contract pay is a consolidated Rs. 1,75,000 per month with an annual increment of 3.00%.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid to a Director appointed on contract?
faq.answer: No. A contract appointee gets consolidated pay and is not entitled to any allowances, including HRA or TA.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for DEPwD Director?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 1000/- by Demand Draft in favour of "PAO, Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities", payable at SBI, Shastri Bhawan, New Delhi, with a separate draft for each application.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply for Director in more than one National Institute?
faq.answer: Yes. Separate applications may be submitted for each National Institute, but multiple applications for the same institute will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q9. What is the tenure of the DEPwD Director post?
faq.answer: The tenure is initially 03 years, extendable up to a maximum of 05 years, subject to applicability as per DoPT norms.

faq.question: Q10. How will DEPwD select the Director?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview, and contract selection will be made only if no suitable deputation candidate is found.
